# Overview System

# **SMART STOCK MOBILE APP**

## **Feature Overview & Functional Specification**

## **1\. Mobile Application Overview**

The mobile application is a field-operation module of the Smart Stock Warehouse Management System (WMS).

It is designed to support warehouse staff in performing warehouse operations quickly, accurately, and efficiently using mobile devices.

In a real-world Warehouse Management System, the web application is mainly responsible for:

* System administration  
* Dashboard and reports  
* Approval workflows  
* System configuration

Meanwhile, the mobile application focuses on warehouse field operations such as:

* Barcode scanning  
* Inventory counting  
* Product lookup  
* Task execution  
* Offline operations

The mobile application follows a mobile-first approach to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual inventory errors.

## **2\. Objectives of the Mobile Application**

The mobile application is developed to:

* Support fast warehouse operations  
* Improve inventory counting accuracy  
* Reduce manual data entry  
* Support barcode and serial tracking  
* Help staff perform inventory checks efficiently  
* Reduce inventory discrepancies  
* Support offline warehouse operations  
* Improve warehouse productivity

## **3\. Target Users**

The mobile application is mainly used by Warehouse Staff.

### **Main Responsibilities**

* Perform inventory counting  
* Scan barcode and serial numbers  
* Check stock information  
* Execute assigned warehouse tasks  
* Update inventory results

Warehouse Managers may also use the application for:

* Monitoring inventory activities  
* Tracking task progress  
* Reviewing discrepancies

## **4\. Mobile Application Scope**

The mobile application only focuses on warehouse operational activities.

Functions such as:

* System administration  
* Dashboard analytics  
* User management  
* Report configuration

are handled by the web application instead of the mobile application.

### **The Mobile System Mainly Supports**

* Inventory operations  
* Barcode scanning  
* Product lookup  
* Task execution  
* Offline synchronization

## **5\. Main Features of the Mobile Application**

### **5.1 Authentication**

#### **Description**

Allows users to securely access the mobile system.

#### **Features**

* User login  
* User logout  
* Secure authentication  
* Role-based access

#### **Purpose**

* Protect warehouse data  
* Ensure authorized access  
* Identify warehouse operators

### **5.2 User Profile and Account Settings**

#### **Description**

Allows users to manage personal account information and application preferences.

#### **Features**

* View profile information  
* Update profile details  
* Change password  
* Logout account  
* View assigned role  
* Manage account security settings

#### **Purpose**

* Improve user account management  
* Enhance account security  
* Personalize user experience

### **5.3 Application Settings**

#### **Description**

Allows users to configure mobile application preferences and operational settings.

#### **Features**

* Dark mode / Light mode  
* Language settings  
* Notification settings  
* Scanner sensitivity settings  
* Auto-sync settings  
* Cache management

#### **Purpose**

* Improve user experience  
* Support different working environments  
* Optimize mobile performance

### **5.4 Inventory Check**

#### **Description**

Supports warehouse staff in performing physical inventory counting operations.

#### **Features**

* View inventory check sessions  
* View inventory check details  
* Scan barcode and serial numbers  
* Enter actual quantity  
* Detect discrepancies  
* Submit inventory counting results

#### **Purpose**

* Compare physical stock with system stock  
* Detect missing or extra inventory  
* Improve inventory accuracy

This is one of the most important features of the mobile application.

### **5.5 Barcode / QR Scanner**

#### **Description**

Provides barcode and QR code scanning functionality for warehouse operations.

#### **Features**

* Scan product barcode  
* Scan QR code  
* Scan serial numbers  
* Quick product lookup  
* Fast stock checking

#### **Purpose**

* Reduce manual input  
* Increase operational speed  
* Improve scanning accuracy

The scanner module is used throughout the mobile application.

### **5.6 Product Detail**

#### **Description**

Allows staff to quickly view product and inventory information after scanning a barcode or serial number.

#### **Features**

* View product information  
* View stock quantity  
* View storage location  
* View batch information  
* View serial information

#### **Purpose**

* Help staff quickly identify products  
* Support warehouse navigation  
* Improve inventory visibility

### **5.7 Inventory Task Management**

#### **Description**

Allows warehouse managers to assign warehouse-related tasks to staff.

#### **Features**

* Receive assigned tasks  
* View task details  
* Update task progress  
* Complete tasks

#### **Example Tasks**

* Count Zone A  
* Check Rack B01  
* Verify serial inventory

#### **Purpose**

* Improve task coordination  
* Track warehouse activities  
* Monitor operational progress

### **5.8 Notifications**

#### **Description**

Provides real-time operational notifications to warehouse staff.

#### **Features**

* Assigned task notifications  
* Inventory discrepancy alerts  
* Low stock alerts  
* Synchronization status notifications

#### **Purpose**

* Improve operational awareness  
* Reduce missed warehouse activities  
* Notify synchronization issues quickly

### **5.9 Offline Synchronization**

#### **Description**

Supports warehouse operations even when the internet connection is unstable or unavailable.

#### **Features**

* Local data storage  
* Pending synchronization queue  
* Failed synchronization handling  
* Retry synchronization  
* Automatic synchronization after reconnecting

#### **Purpose**

* Ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations  
* Prevent data loss  
* Improve reliability in real warehouse environments

Offline synchronization is an important enterprise feature of the system.

### **5.10 Inventory History**

#### **Description**

Allows staff to review previous inventory activities and discrepancy records.

#### **Features**

* View inventory history  
* View discrepancy history  
* View inventory processing records

#### **Purpose**

* Support inventory tracking  
* Improve operational transparency  
* Assist discrepancy investigation

### **5.11 Storage Location Navigation**

#### **Description**

Helps warehouse staff locate products inside the warehouse.

#### **Features**

* View warehouse structure  
* Navigate by:  
  * Zone  
  * Rack  
  * Shelf  
  * Bin

#### **Purpose**

* Improve warehouse navigation  
* Reduce product searching time  
* Support inventory counting by location

### **5.12 Damage and Issue Reporting**

#### **Description**

Allows warehouse staff to report damaged, missing, or incorrect products directly from the warehouse floor.

#### **Features**

* Report damaged products  
* Report missing inventory  
* Attach photos  
* Add issue notes  
* Select issue reason  
* Submit issue reports to managers

#### **Purpose**

* Improve discrepancy handling  
* Support warehouse investigation  
* Reduce inventory inaccuracies  
* Improve warehouse transparency

## **6\. Benefits of the Mobile Application**

The mobile application provides several operational benefits:

* Faster warehouse operations  
* Improved inventory accuracy  
* Reduced manual errors  
* Better barcode and serial tracking  
* Faster inventory counting  
* Improved warehouse visibility  
* Better inventory traceability  
* Support for offline warehouse operations

The system also helps organizations improve warehouse productivity and operational efficiency.

## **7\. Conclusion**

The mobile application is an important operational component of the Smart Stock Warehouse Management System.

The application is designed to support real-world warehouse activities through:

* Barcode scanning  
* Inventory counting  
* Product lookup  
* Task management  
* Offline synchronization

Instead of implementing the entire WMS on mobile devices, the application focuses on warehouse field operations, which is closer to real enterprise WMS architecture.

The mobile application provides a practical and scalable solution suitable for:

* Academic projects  
* Enterprise-oriented capstone projects  
* Portfolio projects  
* Future ERP/WMS development systems

## **A. Overview Flow Screen** {#a.-overview-flow-screen}

![][image1] 

### 

### **Group 1 – App Start** {#group-1-–-app-start}

**Splash Screen**  
Displays the app logo for 1–2 seconds when the app opens. It initializes the connection and checks whether the login token is still valid. If valid, the user is redirected to Home without logging in again.

**Login Screen**  
Allows users to log in with the same account used on the web system. After successful login, the token is saved on the device to maintain the session. Error messages are shown for incorrect credentials or network issues.

**Home Screen**  
The main screen after login. It provides navigation to the main features and may show quick statistics such as unfinished inventory checks, pending sync data, or low-stock alerts.

### **Group 2 – QR / Barcode Scan Flow** {#group-2-–-qr-/-barcode-scan-flow}

**Scan QR / Barcode**  
Opens the camera to scan product barcodes, product QR codes, batch QR codes, or storage location QR codes. This helps users quickly look up information without manual searching.

**Product Detail from Scan**  
Displays detailed product information, including description, unit, available batches, recent stock-in/stock-out history, and inventory status.

### **Group 3 – Storage Location Flow** {#group-3-–-storage-location-flow}

**Storage Location List**  
Shows all warehouse locations such as shelves, cabinets, or damaged-goods areas. Each location includes its code, name, number of stored products, and notes.

**Product Detail from Location**  
Displays product details from a selected storage location. Staff can view product information, start an inventory check, or report an issue from this screen.

### **Group 4 – Inventory Check Flow** {#group-4-–-inventory-check-flow}

**Inventory Check List**  
Shows all inventory check sessions with statuses such as Draft, Submitted, Approved, and Rejected. Staff can create a new session or continue an unfinished one.

**Inventory Check Detail**  
The main screen for the inventory process. It shows checked and unchecked products, system quantity, actual quantity, and differences. Staff actions update the results on this screen.

**Sync Status after Submit**  
Shows the submission progress, including whether the inventory form, images, and notes have been synced. Statuses include Pending, Syncing, Synced, and Failed. Failed items can be retried.

### **Group 5 – Inventory History** {#group-5-–-inventory-history}

**Inventory History**  
Shows completed inventory check sessions sorted by date. It includes the form code, date, staff member, location, number of differences, and approval status.

**Inventory History Detail**  
Displays the details of a completed inventory session, including product lines, system quantity, actual quantity, differences, photos, notes, approval result, and rejection reason if any. This screen is view-only.

### **Group 6 – Data Synchronization** {#group-6-–-data-synchronization}

**Sync Status from Home**  
Provides an overview of all local data synchronization, including pending forms, unuploaded images, and failed data.

**Sync Now**  
Allows staff to manually start synchronization immediately, especially after the network connection is restored.

**Retry Failed Sync**  
Shows failed sync items and allows staff to retry each item or retry all. It also displays the failure reason.

**Offline Pending Data**  
Shows all data stored locally but not yet sent to the server, such as inventory forms, photos, and notes.

### **Group 7 – Notifications** {#group-7-–-notifications}

**Notifications**  
Displays push notifications from the server, such as assigned inventory tasks, approval results, rejected forms, low-stock alerts, and sync errors.

**Inventory Task Detail from Notification**  
Shows the assigned inventory task, including the required location, deadline, and manager’s notes. Staff can start the task directly from this screen.

**Inventory Result Detail from Notification**  
Shows the manager’s approval result, including whether the form was approved or rejected, the rejection reason, and any required follow-up actions.

### **Group 8 – Incident Report Flow**  {#group-8-–-incident-report-flow}

**Create Incident Report**

Allows staff to report warehouse issues such as damaged products, missing items, wrong storage locations, broken shelves, incorrect quantity, or barcode/QR code errors. Staff can enter a description, select the related product or location, attach photos, and submit the report.

#### **1.4 User Flow**

##### **1.4.1 Main Flow**

1\. User opens the application.

2\. The system displays the Login Screen.

3\. User enters their employee ID or email and password.

4\. User presses the Login Button.

5\. The system verifies the account.

6\. Login successful → proceeds to the Home Screen.

| Tap Login Button | Home Screen |
| Tap Forgot Password | Forgot Password Screen |
| Tap Login with Google | Google Auth Flow |

| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |

| Header | App Logo Icon | Image | Smart Stock branding icon. |
| Body | Instruction Text | Label | Short description guiding the user to fill in details. |
| Body | Warehouse Name Dropdown | Dropdown Select | Select the warehouse to be checked. |
| Body | Location Input | Text Input | Enter the specific shelf or zone location (e.g., Kệ A-12, Khu vực 1). |

| Footer | Start Inventory Check Button | Primary Button | Validates form and initiates the inventory check session. |

#### **5.4 User Flow**

##### **5.4.1 Main Flow**

1\. User taps the (+) FAB from the Inventory Check List Screen.

2\. System displays the Create Inventory Check Screen.

3\. User selects a warehouse from the dropdown.

4\. User enters the location, confirms the date, and optionally adds notes.

5\. User taps 'Bắt đầu kiểm kê' (Start Inventory Check).

6\. System validates all required fields.

7\. System creates the session and navigates to the Inventory Check Detail Screen.

##### **5.4.2 Navigation Flow**

| Action | Destination |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tap Back Arrow | Inventory Check List Screen |
| Tap 'Bắt đầu kiểm kê' (valid form) | Inventory Check Detail Screen |

| Header | More Options Icon | Icon Button | Opens additional options menu. |
| Body | Session Info Row \- Voucher Code | Label | Displays the session voucher ID (e.g., INV-2023-001) in red. |
| Body | Session Info Row \- Warehouse | Label | Displays the warehouse name (e.g., Kho Chính \- Tầng 1). |

| Body | Product Item Card \- Discrepancy | List Item Card | Warning icon; shown when actual quantity differs from system quantity. |
| Body | Product Item Card \- Pending | List Item Card | Question mark icon; dashes shown in actual quantity field for items not yet counted. |
| Body | Actual Quantity Input | Number Input | User inputs the physically counted quantity for each item. |

#### **7.4 User Flow**

##### **7.4.1 Main Flow**

1\. User taps a session card from the Inventory Check List Screen.

2\. System loads and displays session metadata and all product items.

3\. User enters the actual counted quantity for each product item.

4\. User can use Quick Scan QR to scan serial/lot codes.

5\. User taps 'Lưu tạm' to save progress, or 'Hoàn thành' to finalize the session.

6\. On 'Hoàn thành', system validates all items and submits the session.

##### **7.4.2 Navigation Flow**

| Action | Destination |
| :---- | :---- |

| Tap Quick Scan QR | QR Scanner Screen |

| Tap Lưu tạm | Inventory Check List Screen (session saved as draft) |

### **10\. Confirm & Sync Screen**

#### **10.1 General Information**

| Screen Name | Confirm & Sync Screen |
| :---- | :---- |
| Screen ID | SCR\_SYNC\_01 |
| Module | Sync / Offline Management |
| Purpose | Allow users to view offline-pending inventory sessions and manually trigger synchronization when connectivity is restored. |
| User/Actor | Warehouse Staff |

#### **10.2 Wireframe**

![][image14]

#### **10.3 UI Components**

| Section | Component | Data Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Header | Back Arrow | Icon Button | Returns to the previous screen. |
| Header | Screen Title | Label | Displays 'Xác nhận & Đồng bộ' (Confirm & Sync). |
| Header | Notification Bell | Icon Button | Navigates to the Notification Screen. |
| Body | Offline Status Card | Status Card | Displays a cloud-off icon, 'Ngoại tuyến' (Offline) label, and 'Mất kết nối mạng' message. |
| Body | Pending Data Card | Info Card | Shows number of inventory sessions waiting to be synced (e.g., 8 phiên kiểm kê). |
| Body | Last Sync Card | Info Card | Displays timestamp of last successful sync (e.g., 14:30, Hôm nay, 24/10/2023). |
| Body | Pending Sessions Section Title | Label | Section heading 'Chi tiết phiên chờ' (Pending Session Details). |
| Body | Pending Session Item \- Pending | List Item Card | Shows session ID, 'Pending' status badge, zone, product count, last updated time, and 'XEM CHI TIẾT' button. |
| Body | Pending Session Item \- Failed | List Item Card | Shows session ID, 'Failed' status badge (red), zone, error message, and 'XEM CHI TIẾT' button. |
| Footer | Sync Now Button (Đồng bộ ngay) | Primary Button | Triggers manual synchronization (disabled/greyed out when offline). |

#### **10.4 User Flow**

##### **10.4.1 Main Flow**

1\. User opens the Confirm & Sync Screen (e.g., after returning from offline work).

2\. System detects network status and displays Offline/Online accordingly.

3\. System lists all pending sessions awaiting sync.

4\. User reviews each pending or failed session by tapping 'XEM CHI TIẾT'.

5\. When connectivity is restored, user taps 'Đồng bộ ngay' to upload all pending data.

6\. System syncs data and updates session statuses.

##### **10.4.2 Navigation Flow**

| Action | Destination |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tap Back Arrow | Previous Screen |
| Tap XEM CHI TIẾT on a session | Inventory Check Detail Screen (read-only) |
| Tap Đồng bộ ngay (online) | Sync Progress / Result Screen |

#### **14.4 User Flow**

##### **14.4.1 Main Flow**

1\. User navigates to the Warehouse Location Screen from the Home Screen quick access.

2\. System loads and displays the warehouse zone/row/bin structure.

3\. User browses by tapping area filter chips or scrolling the list.

4\. User can tap a sub-bin link to drill down into a specific storage bin.

5\. User taps 'Xem bản đồ' to open the Warehouse Map for a visual overview.

##### **14.4.2 Navigation Flow**

| Action | Destination |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tap a sub-bin link | Bin Detail Screen |
| Tap Xem bản đồ | Warehouse Map Screen |
| Tap QR Scan icon in search | QR Scanner Screen |
| Tap Quét vị trí (footer) | QR Scanner Screen |

### **15\. Warehouse Map Screen**

#### **15.1 General Information**

| Screen Name | Warehouse Map Screen |
| :---- | :---- |
| Screen ID | SCR\_WH\_MAP\_01 |
| Module | Warehouse Management |
| Purpose | Display an interactive visual map of warehouse zones/bins with color-coded capacity status, and allow users to locate themselves in the warehouse. |
| User/Actor | Warehouse Staff / Warehouse Manager |

#### **15.2 Wireframe**

![][image19]

#### **15.3 UI Components**

| Section | Component | Data Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Header | Back Arrow | Icon Button | Returns to the Warehouse Location Screen. |
| Header | Screen Title | Label | Displays 'Bản đồ Kho' (Warehouse Map). |
| Body | Legend Card | Info Card | Color-coding legend: Red \= Full/Warning (\>90%), Teal \= Normal (\<90%), Light Grey \= Empty. |
| Body | Zone Column Headers | Label Row | Displays column headers for each zone (e.g., Khu A, Khu B, Khu C). |
| Body | Bin Tile — Full/Warning (Red) | Tappable Tile | Red tile indicating bin capacity \> 90%. Tap to view bin detail. |
| Body | Bin Tile — Normal (Teal) | Tappable Tile | Teal tile indicating bin capacity \< 90%. Tap to view bin detail. |
| Body | Bin Tile — Empty (Grey) | Tappable Tile | Grey tile indicating an empty bin. Tap to view bin detail. |
| Body | Current Location Marker | Overlay Icon | Person icon overlay showing the user's current position on the map. |
| Body | Zoom In Button (+) | Icon Button | Zooms in on the map. |
| Body | Zoom Out Button (−) | Icon Button | Zooms out on the map. |
| Body | Re-center / Locate Button | Icon Button | Re-centers the map on the user's current location. |
| Footer | Scan Location Button | Primary Button | Opens QR scanner to scan a location code. |
| Footer | Detail List Button | Secondary Button | Opens the Warehouse Location list view. |

#### **15.4 User Flow**

##### **15.4.1 Main Flow**

1\. User taps 'Xem bản đồ' from the Warehouse Location Screen.

2\. System loads and renders the warehouse map with color-coded bin tiles.

3\. User views the legend to understand capacity color codes.

4\. User taps a bin tile to view that bin's detail.

5\. User uses Zoom In/Out and Re-center controls to navigate the map.

##### **15.4.2 Navigation Flow**

| Action | Destination |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tap Back Arrow | Warehouse Location Screen |
| Tap a bin tile | Bin Detail Screen |
| Tap Quét vị trí (footer) | QR Scanner Screen |
| Tap Danh sách chi tiết | Warehouse Location Screen |
| Tap Re-center button | Map re-centers on current location (same screen) |

### **16\. Incident Report Screen**

#### **16.1 General Information**

| Screen Name | Incident Report Screen |
| :---- | :---- |
| Screen ID | SCR\_INCIDENT\_01 |
| Module | Warehouse Management / Reporting |
| Purpose | Allow users to report incidents or issues with products in the warehouse, including attaching photos and descriptions. |
| User/Actor | Warehouse Staff / Warehouse Manager |

#### **16.2 Wireframe**

![][image20]

#### **16.3 UI Components**

| Section | Component | Data Type | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Header | Back Arrow | Icon Button | Returns to the previous screen. |
| Header | Screen Title | Label | Displays 'Báo cáo Sự cố' (Incident Report) in red. |
| Header | App Logo Icon | Image | Smart Stock branding icon. |
| Body | Product / SKU Field | Text Input \+ QR Button | Search or scan to select the product/SKU involved in the incident. Required field. |
| Body | Current Location Field | Read-Only Text | Auto-populated with the user's current warehouse location (e.g., Khu vực A • Kệ 04 • Tầng 2). |
| Body | Incident Type Dropdown | Dropdown Select | Select the type of incident (required field). |
| Body | Affected Quantity Control | Number Stepper | Adjust the number of affected items using minus/plus buttons (default: 1). |
| Body | Attach Photos Section | Image Upload | Capture or select up to 4 images as evidence (1 photo slot \+ 3 empty slots shown). |
| Body | Detailed Notes Input | Multi-line Text Input | Describe the incident in detail to support the resolution process. |
| Footer | Submit Report Button | Primary Button | Submits the incident report. |

#### **16.4 User Flow**

##### **16.4.1 Main Flow**

1\. User navigates to the Incident Report Screen (e.g., from a product detail or task context).

2\. System auto-fills the current warehouse location.

3\. User searches or scans to select the affected product/SKU.

4\. User selects the incident type from the dropdown.

5\. User adjusts the affected quantity using the stepper.

6\. User optionally attaches up to 4 photos.

7\. User enters detailed notes describing the incident.

8\. User taps 'Gửi báo cáo' to submit the report.

9\. System validates required fields (Product/SKU and Incident Type) and submits.

##### **16.4.2 Navigation Flow**

| Action | Destination |
| :---- | :---- |
| Tap Back Arrow | Previous Screen |
| Tap QR icon in Product/SKU field | QR Scanner Screen |
| Tap Gửi báo cáo (valid form) | Report Confirmation / Success Screen |
